{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing systematic undershoot that corrects within 5-10 days",
    "The forecast lag is most pronounced on days with negative sentiment (sentiment < 0), where true prices rise while model predicts flat or declining prices",
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (1.00), model forecasts underperform by 2-4 points compared to reality",
    "Mean reversion bias exists: model centers forecasts around current price levels rather than accounting for momentum embedded in sentiment signals",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive correlates with largest forecast errors as model lags behind rapid price adjustments",
    "Forecast divergence increases with horizon - 30-day forecasts exceed true values by 3-5 points on day 20-30 while being 3-5 points low in early days",
    "When price history shows clear upward trend, model under-forecasts by failing to fully incorporate the momentum signal from recent sentiment"
] }
